part.text:
Refactored the SSG to a plugin architecture. All 67 tests pass (external API unchanged).

**New files**
- `src/plugins/types.ts` — `Plugin` interface (`onStart`, `beforeBuild`, `afterBuild`, `onFile`, `onEnd`), `PluginContext`, `PluginFactory`, `SSGConfig`
- `src/plugins/markdown-plugin.ts` — MarkdownPlugin (parses `*.md`, frontmatter → `Page`)
- `src/plugins/template-plugin.ts` — TemplatePlugin (resolves template dir, renders/writes pages + index via Handlebars or built-in rendering)
- `src/plugins/dev-server-plugin.ts` — DevServerPlugin (live-reload server; rebuilds through the pipeline on file changes)
- `src/plugins/index.ts` — `defaultPlugins(command)` built-in set
- `src/engine.ts` — `SsgEngine`: orchestrates the pipeline `onStart → beforeBuild → onFile (per file) → afterBuild → onEnd`, in plugin registration order; both sync (`buildSync`/`runSync`) and async (`build`/`run`)
- `src/load-plugins.ts` — loads `ssg.config.ts` and TypeScript plugin modules from `./plugins/` at runtime (via a `.ts` CommonJS loader)
- `src/render.ts` — shared built-in `renderPage`/`renderIndex` used by both generator and plugins

**Refactored**
- `src/generator.ts` — `buildSite` now runs the engine with built-in plugins; `renderPage`, `renderIndex`, `escapeHtml`, `BuildOptions` re-exported unchanged
- `src/dev-server.ts` — `startDevServer` drives the engine + DevServerPlugin; `LiveReloadDevServer` accepts an optional `rebuild` callback; all exports preserved
- `src/cli.ts` — loads `ssg.config.ts`, merges config dirs with CLI flags, and passes config plugins into build/serve
